name: TurboCharge 65W USB-C Wall Charger
description: Charge your devices at lightning speed with the TurboCharge 65W USB‑C Wall Charger, compatible with laptops, phones, and tablets, and includes a foldable plug for travel.
shortDescription: 65W USB‑C wall charger with foldable plug.

name: SmartHome Wi-Fi Light Switch
description: Control lighting from anywhere using the SmartHome Wi‑Fi Light Switch, which integrates with Aria and Corvex Assistant for voice‑activated on/off and dimming.
shortDescription: Wi‑Fi enabled light switch compatible with voice assistants.

name: KiddoPlay Magnetic Building Blocks
description: Unleash creativity with KiddoPlay Magnetic Building Blocks, a set of 200 pieces that snap together magnetically to build endless structures for kids aged 4 and up.
shortDescription: Magnetic building block set for imaginative play.

name: ChronoTech Analog Watch with Leather Strap
description: Stay punctual and stylish with the ChronoTech Analog Watch, featuring a genuine leather strap, sapphire‑crystal face, and water resistance up to 30 meters.
shortDescription: Classic analog watch with leather strap and sapphire crystal.

name: PureGlow LED Vanity Mirror
description: Upgrade your vanity with the PureGlow LED Vanity Mirror, offering adjustable brightness, touch‑controlled dimming, and a built‑in USB charging port.
shortDescription: LED vanity mirror with touch dimming and USB charging.

name: EcoGuard Reusable Grocery Bags (Pack of 10)
description: Reduce single‑use plastic with the EcoGuard Reusable Grocery Bags, a pack of 10 sturdy, washable bags made from recycled PET material.
shortDescription: Set of 10 reusable, washable grocery bags.
